sources.quote: Part card BR-310, roof rail bracket for the Nordhavn Fjell (PRG-Y).
5.2 A change of coating requires Nordhavn approval before the first shipment.

findings.why: BR-310 belongs to the Nordhavn Fjell program. Changing the coating from trivalent to yellow chromate needs Nordhavn approval before the first shipment. No approval or deviation in force covers it. DEV-125 only covers packing.

sources.quote: COAT-CCC-YELLOW,Yellow chromate conversion coating on aluminium,CrVI

findings.why: The yellow chromate coating contains hexavalent chromium (CrVI). The documents given contain no legal restriction list. This finding rests on the general legal restriction of CrVI in the part's market, which is not in the documents, so please confirm it.
